summary: Comprehensive testing of Resellr OS mobile app completed. Backend: 25/25 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All critical flows working correctly including tab navigation, source calculator with verdict display, inventory filters, pipeline stages, insights analytics, and settings management. Minor selector issue with duplicate text elements but no functional issues found.

issues: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in favor of 'boxShadow' (non-blocking)
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents should use style.pointerEvents (non-blocking)

action_items: Update shadow props to use boxShadow syntax to remove deprecation warnings
Consider adding unique testIDs to duplicate text elements (e.g., tab labels vs screen headers) for more robust testing
